page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin, one note beside the lines "Agrarii ordines" to "runt"; at the foot right, the catchword. Running head at top: "Deque Vrbe Groninga", page number 179 at top right.

main_text.p: tibus conclavis valvis, sententiam tulere. Quæ ut intelligi possit, quæ partium postulata fuerint, aperiendum. Agrarii Postulata partis utrinsque.or-dines secuti vestigia consiliorum priorum de solvendo fœdere, divortium postula-runt, separationem integram per quam sibi consulerent seorsim, suamque tene-rent remp. divisam à civitate, nec quicquam cum hac haberent commune, præ-ter viciniam & commercia libera. Speciatim verò Hovetmannorum à senatu oppidano datorum jurisdictionem recu-sabant omninò, conventus habere suos, quando & ubi commodum sibi, seclusâ civitate,in iis de rep. consultare & statue-re, collegium provinciale suum tenere, judices summos exse edere volebant: jus fori rerum venalium in oppido,&id quod de frumento&cerevisia dixi, ex fœderibus promanans, in universum rescissum cupiebant. Minora mittoCivitas contra,conjunctionem solitam summa ratione insti-tutam olim, longissimoque tempore pro-batam, transactionibus & decretis multis roboratam, poscebat: Hovetmannorum electionem& potestatem ex more prisco, & quæ

page.notes: Catchword "& quæ:" is at the foot right and is taken as the catchword; the final mark may be a colon or a stop. "contra,con" / "junctionem": no hyphen is printed at the line end, so the word is written whole as conjunctionem. "mittoCivitas" is printed without a space. "infti-" is read as insti-tutam but is doubtful. "exse" is printed with long s. The paragraph is one continuous paragraph across the page; no indented line starts a new one. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is left out.
